title: Grouped dwellings address the street
text: Grouped dwellings are to address the street (including a battleaxe driveway, communal street or right-of-way where this is the primary frontage) in accordance with the following: i. the primary entrance to each dwelling must be readily identifiable from the street; and ii. provide at least one major opening on the dwelling frontage with an outlook to the street.

parts.label: (i) primary entrance readily identifiable from the street
(ii) at least one major opening on the frontage with outlook to the street

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same test as Chapter 2 C3.6.1; Chapter 3 says 'grouped dwellings' and 'the primary entrance to each dwelling'. Both limbs required for every dwelling; the facts answer for the worst dwelling. Street includes a battleaxe driveway, communal street or ROW where that is the primary frontage.
